question: Should OpenClaw remove these 37 shipped bundled skills now, or should the safe Sherpa and ClawHub installation work land separately until upgrade migration and replacement publication are complete?
rationale: The remaining change intentionally alters the shipped starter product and upgrade experience; code review cannot choose that compatibility policy, and maintainer discussion already identifies it as a parked decision surface.

options.title: Split safe plumbing first
options.body: Land Sherpa packaging and ClawHub-only official install routing separately, while deferring bundled-skill removals until migrations and replacement packages are ready.

options.title: Complete the full trim
options.body: Keep the combined direction but require doctor migration, verified replacement publication, current-head dependency authorization, and fresh-plus-upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the deprecation
options.body: Retain the current bundled starter set and close or park the removal portion if maintainers do not want to own the compatibility and catalog work now.

recommendation.title: Split safe plumbing first
recommendation.body: Land Sherpa packaging and ClawHub-only official install routing separately, while deferring bundled-skill removals until migrations and replacement packages are ready.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the focused splits and explicitly described the remaining product decision and validation state.
